title: Scale a registration increment
hook: Two stated cases: explore the population behind a projected registration count.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the population behind a projected registration count affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the population behind a projected registration count in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy program has 1e+06 eligible units, uptake fraction 0.1, and added amount 1 per participant. What total is added?
